name: qartez_map
description: Files ranked by PageRank with their exports and blast radius (by=symbols ranks symbols). Use first in an unfamiliar repo. To locate a known name use qartez_find; to rank around a task pass boost_terms or boost_files.

all_files.description: Rank every file, tests and files without symbols included (ignores top_n).

boost_files.description: Paths to rank higher (x10), e.g. files named in the task.

boost_terms.description: Words; files whose path or symbol names contain one rank higher (x5).

format.description: concise: file rows only. detailed (default): plus up to 6 exported signatures per file.

name: qartez_find
description: Definition of a symbol by exact name: file, line range, signature, exported or private. Takes qualified names (Type.method, Module.fn, stem::fn). For part of a name use qartez_grep; for its uses, qartez_refs.

format.description: concise: name and file. detailed (default): plus signature.

kind.description: Only this kind: function, method, struct, class, extension, …

name.description: Exact or qualified name, or a regex with regex=true. Aliases: symbol, symbol_name.

regex.description: Treat name as an unanchored, case-insensitive regex.

name: qartez_grep
description: Symbols whose name starts with a prefix (case-insensitive): kind, file, lines, exported or private. Use for a partial or unsure name; for an exact name qartez_find is shorter. search_bodies=true finds text inside function bodies instead.

format.description: concise: names only. detailed (default): kind, file and lines.

kind.description: Only this kind: function, method, struct, …

query.description: Name prefix (Foo = Foo*), a regex with regex=true, or text with search_bodies=true. Alias: pattern.

regex.description: Treat query as an unanchored, case-insensitive regex.

search_bodies.description: Search the text of function bodies, not names: rows are path:line in function: text.

name: qartez_read
description: Source of one or more symbols, or a file's line range, with line numbers. Use after qartez_find or qartez_grep instead of reading whole files. For a file's list of symbols use qartez_outline.

file_path.description: Alone: read this file (or start_line..end_line). With a symbol: pick it from this file. Aliases: file, path.

start_line.description: First line of the range (1-based). Alias: offset.

symbol_name.description: One symbol to read. Aliases: symbol, name.

symbols.description: Several symbols to read in one call.

with.description: ["callers"] adds up to 5 callers with signature and call-site line, saving a calls + read round trip. Off by default.

name: qartez_outline
description: Every symbol in one file, grouped by kind, with line ranges and signatures. Use to see a file's structure before reading it; for a symbol's code use qartez_read.

format.description: concise: names and lines. detailed (default): plus signatures.

offset.description: Skip this many symbols (pages of 100; the output gives next_offset).

name: qartez_deps
description: A file's direct imports and direct importers. Use for one file's coupling; for everything a change could break (transitive, co-change) use qartez_impact.

format.description: concise: paths. detailed (default): with import specifiers. mermaid: a diagram, only if asked for one.

name: qartez_stats
description: Counts: files, LOC, symbols and edges by language, and the most imported files. With file_path: that file's LOC, symbols, imports, importers and PageRank.

file_path.description: Optional file for per-file numbers. Aliases: file, path.

name: qartez_impact
description: What a change to a file could break: importers and co-change partners ranked together (seeded from the worktree diff), the linked tests, then transitive dependents and hot symbols. Call before editing a widely imported file (the edit guard asks for it). One symbol's uses: qartez_refs; direct imports only: qartez_deps.

file_path.description: The file. Aliases: file, path, name.

include_tests.description: Count test files in the ranked list and blast radius (default false). The Tests group lists linked tests either way.

seed_diff.description: Also rank co-change partners of files the worktree changed, not just file_path (default true).

name: qartez_refs
description: Every reference to a symbol (calls, type uses, imports), grouped by file with line and enclosing function. Use before renaming or deleting, or to see all uses. Calls only, or chains past one hop: qartez_calls. A whole file: qartez_impact.

format.description: concise: files only. detailed (default): each reference.

include_tests.description: Include references from test files (default true).

symbol.description: Symbol name; Type.member narrows. Aliases: name, symbol_name.

transitive.description: Also list the files that depend on the referencing files.

name: qartez_calls
description: Callers and callees of a function, up to 10 hops. Use to follow a call chain; for every kind of use (types, imports) use qartez_refs. A name with several definitions needs file_path or kind.

depth.description: Hops to follow (default 1, max 10; 0 = target only). 2 or more returns a signature-only call tree.

file_path.description: File that defines the function, if the name is ambiguous.

format.description: concise: names. detailed (default): with paths and lines. mermaid: a diagram, only if asked for one.

include_tests.description: Include callers in test files (default false).

kind.description: Kind of the definition (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

name.description: Function or method name. Aliases: symbol, symbol_name.

name: qartez_replace_symbol
description: Replace a symbol's whole definition, signature included, with new_code. To add code beside it use qartez_insert_before_symbol or qartez_insert_after_symbol. Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: The full new definition, starting with its signature.

name: qartez_insert_before_symbol
description: Insert new_code on the line above a symbol's definition. Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: Code to insert; a trailing newline is added if missing.

name: qartez_insert_after_symbol
description: Insert new_code on the line below a symbol's definition. Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: Code to insert; a trailing newline is added if missing.

name: qartez_rename
description: Rename a symbol everywhere: definition, resolved references, import and exposing lists; strings and comments are left alone. For a file use qartez_rename_file. Preview unless apply=true.

allow_collision.description: Rename even if new_name is already defined in a file it rewrites.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_move
description: Move a top-level symbol to another file and repoint its importers (Elm, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust). Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_safe_delete
description: Delete a symbol, listing every reference that would break; refuses while any remain unless force=true. Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

force.description: Delete even with references left; you fix them.

kind.description: Kind of the symbol (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_rename_file
description: Rename or move a file and rewrite the imports that name it (Elm, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust). Preview unless apply=true.

apply.description: true writes the change; default false shows the diff only.

name: qartez_add_root
description: Start indexing a directory now so later queries need not wait. Optional: any path is indexed when first asked about.

name: qartez_workspace
description: As qartez_add_root: action=add starts indexing path now; action=remove does nothing.
